skillset.skill: 12s CT - For 12s, heal for 10% of DMG taken, increase Freeze and Paralysis RES by 100%.
skillset.arts: For 20s, increase Allies' DMG by 25%, redirect Allies' DMG taken to self and gain a DMG barrier that negates 11000 DMG to self. 0 BREAK
skillset.truearts: 80% chance to inflict Faint for 7s. If at least 1 enemy is inflicted with Faint: 55000% Dark DMG (PHY). This attack ignores 100% of enemy DEF. If no enemies are inflicted with Faint: On hit, heal self by 60% + Increase own Arts by 100 (this deals no BREAK to the enemy as well).

passive.ability1: Increase DEF by 20% when under a DMG barrier.
passive.ability2: At the start of a Quest, for 20s, grant Allies a DMG barrier that negates 3000 DMG. Normal attacks increase own DMG RES by 10% for 2s.

true1.name: Small Shield
true1.skill: 45s CT - For 10s, increase target's DEF by 60%, DMG RES by 40%, and target heals for 10% of DMG taken.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Naofumi, increase HP by 25% + Increase own Arts by 1/s.

true2.name: Wrath Shield
true2.skill: 35s CT - For 20s, heal Target's HP by 3%/s. If user is Light, cure Target's Seal.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Naofumi, increase PHY RES by 35%, and increase barrier gained from own Arts by 4000.
